note: Overrides only (ADR-0160 §5; ut-docs#4367, #4640). A language added in Weblate is built by the publish workflow with no change here: its code, display name and script are derived (tools/locales.py), it publishes through bundle-publish without the human spot-check and with no min_coverage. An entry below changes that for one Weblate language code. Allowed fields: source (built from this repo's English), human_spot_check (en/de/tr publish through bundle-publish-human, ADR-0160 §4), min_coverage (share of the keys the bundle must hold before it may publish: set for de/es/pt, whose 2.x bundle replaces an installed ut-plugin-language-* pack of ~3,470 strings under the same id), script (ISO 15924), name (exact manifest name). Any other field is refused. An entry for a code Weblate does not list is never published.
